SourceProxy.name: ttkSierpinskiKnoppWassersteinDistance
SourceProxy.label: TTK Sierpinski-Knopp Projection
SourceProxy.Documentation: Projects two normalized persistence diagrams onto the unit interval with the finite-level Sierpinski-Knopp selector. The output contains one point for each off-diagonal atom and one point for its diagonal projection. The filter accepts either two vtkUnstructuredGrid diagrams on two input ports or one vtkMultiBlockDataSet containing at least two diagrams on the first input port.

InputProperty.name: InputDiagram0
InputProperty.Documentation: First normalized persistence diagram, or a multiblock containing at least two persistence diagrams.

InputProperty.name: InputDiagram1
InputProperty.Documentation: Second normalized persistence diagram. This input is optional if the first input is a multiblock containing at least two diagrams.

IntVectorProperty.name: L
IntVectorProperty.label: SK Level
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: Finite refinement level used to approximate the SK first-hit selector.

IntVectorProperty.name: AddLineSegment
IntVectorProperty.label: Add Unit Segment
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: Whether to add the segment [0,1] as a line cell in the output.

StringVectorProperty.name: OutputArrayPrefix
StringVectorProperty.label: Output Array Prefix
StringVectorProperty.Documentation: Prefix used for the output point-data arrays.
